candidate.answerReason: The factors 1000, 10, and 0.1993 multiply to 1993, leaving 1993 × 1993.

methods.label: Regroup and scale the decimal
methods.explanation:
Group \(1000\) and \(10\) with the decimal. Their product is \(10{,}000\), so multiplying \(0.1993\) by them moves its decimal point four places to the right:
\[1000\cdot10\cdot0.1993=1993.\]
By the commutative and associative properties of multiplication, the original product is therefore
\[1993\cdot(1000\cdot10\cdot0.1993)=1993\cdot1993.\]
This equals \((1993)^2\), choice \(\mathrm E\).
